name: SciFact
description: A scientific claim verification benchmark requiring models to retrieve and reason over scientific papers to verify or refute claims. Contains 1,409 scientific claims paired with 5,183 annotated abstracts from scientific literature.
reputation: Standard benchmark for scientific fact verification; used in BEIR retrieval benchmark suite
notes: Claims are written by domain experts; abstracts from biomedical and scientific literature. Requires retrieval and natural language inference. Part of the BEIR information retrieval benchmark suite.
